info.name: Kirenz | Integration & cross-service regression
info.description: Ordered, real-Docker HTTP integration tests. Fresh run-scoped actors only. Brevo is replaced by a local mailbox stub; databases, Kafka, Redis, Eureka and service-to-service Feign calls are real. Default LiveKit is intentionally unreachable: call orchestration is tested, media/provider success is not. SECURITY/REGRESSION cases assert the intended rejection/behavior and may expose existing application bugs. npm test also prepares a local admin and emits redacted JSON/JUnit reports. Never run against production.
